title: field_ops.settlement.closed v1
description: The end-of-day settlement of one person in the field was closed (ADR-37 §18.4 "Corte del día"): what was expected for their local day — the day's cash in the collections book collected by them, the balance of their truck in the inventory book — against what they declared, within the tenant's settlement_tolerance. Closing wrote each stock difference to the inventory book as an adjustment of document settlement (one field_ops.inventory.moved each) and marked the day's delivered sales of the seller settled. A settlement above the tolerance waits for an authorization and is never announced until it closes. Emitted once per settlement AFTER the transaction that closed it commits; closing again is not announced again. A closed settlement is never edited: a later correction is a movement on the day it happens. Source publisher: alebrije-mod-field-ops-ex Workers.EventPublisher, relaying the [:alebrije_field_ops, :settlement, :closed] telemetry event that AlebrijeFieldOps.Settlements fires. The envelope is built by AlebrijeCommon.Events.Publish.build_envelope/3, so every field below lives under `data` (telemetry metadata stringified, measurements prefixed with m_). Amounts are decimal strings with at most two decimals, never floats; differences are signed (negative = missing).

settlement_id.description: The field_ops.settlements row. Stable: a consumer dedups on it.

tenant_id.description: Tenant that owns the settlement (ADR-25). Repeated inside data because the producer copies the telemetry metadata verbatim.

context_id.description: Branch (context) the settlement was declared in, when known.

seller_id.description: The person in the field (a field technician): their truck and their cash.

business_date.description: Their local day (branch timezone, else the tenant's) the settlement covers.

currency.description: ISO 4217 code of every amount below.

expected_cash.description: The day's cash collected by them in the collections book, reversals included (negative only if they returned more than they collected).

card_total.description: The day's money by card confirmed by payments-go, for the record.

transfer_total.description: The day's money by transfer confirmed by payments-go, for the record.

credit_total.description: The balances they left on credit that day, for the record.

stock_difference_value.description: Σ (counted − book balance) × catalog-copy price over the truck's parts; negative = missing product.

total_difference.description: cash_difference + stock_difference_value; within the tenant's tolerance, or it would not have closed.

sales_count.description: Delivered sales of the day that this close marked settled.
